segments.he: אָמַר רָבָא: לָא תֵּימָא סָפֵק חֲזָא סָפֵק לָא חֲזָא. אֶלָּא וַדַּאי חֲזָא, סָפֵק מֵחֲמַת שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע, סָפֵק מֵחֲמַת רְאִיָּיה. כֵּיוָן שֶׁנִּזְקַק לְטוּמְאָה — סְפֵיקוֹ טָמֵא.
segments.en: «Rava said: Do not say» that it is «uncertain» whether he «saw» a discharge and «uncertain» whether he «did not see» one. The uncertainty is not with regard to whether he experienced a discharge at all. «Rather, he certainly saw a» discharge, but it is «uncertain» whether the discharge was «due to,» i.e., defined as, an emission of «semen,» and it is «uncertain» whether the discharge was «due to» the «sighting» of ziva. In this case, «once he has been confirmed as being ritually impure» as a zav, «his uncertain» case is also «impure.»

moves.summary: the doubt is about the type of a certain discharge

edges.about: the mishna's 'uncertain' means a certain discharge of uncertain type (semen or ziva), not uncertain whether seen

positions.claim: uncertainty is whether a certain discharge was semen or ziva; then it is impure
